headline: No 14.2 Kg Gas Without e-KYC; 10 Kg Cylinder Must Be Bought at a Very High Price Under FTL Scheme
summary: Customers who have not completed e-KYC cannot buy 14.2 kg gas cylinders at subsidised terms and must pay market rates for a 10 kg cylinder under the FTL scheme.
why: LPG pricing and distribution policy in India affects household energy costs, state-run oil marketing companies, and the broader fuel subsidy budget.
